sql.query: SELECT COALESCE(b.primaryColour,'#18B99A') primaryColour,COALESCE(b.accentColour,'#00D7A3') accentColour,COALESCE(b.headerColour,'#073F3C') headerColour,COALESCE(b.sidebarColour,'#092F2D') sidebarColour,COALESCE(NULLIF(b.logoPath,''),'/assets/images/tastrack_logo.png') logoPath,COALESCE(NULLIF(b.contractLogoPath,''),NULLIF(b.logoPath,''),'/assets/images/tastrack_logo.png') contractLogoPath,COALESCE(b.defaultColourMode,'light') defaultColourMode,COALESCE(b.rowVersion,1) rowVersion,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='branding.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=t.id AND utr.isActive=1) AS UNSIGNED) canManage FROM tbl_tenants t LEFT JOIN tbl_tenant_branding b ON b.tenantId=t.id WHERE t.id=:tenantId LIMIT 1
